title: Utegymsindex 2026: outdoor gyms per 10,000 residents in Sweden's 290 municipalities
description:
Outdoor gym sites and lit exercise tracks per 10,000 residents for every Swedish municipality, with rank, as registered in OpenStreetMap (extract 2026-11-13), with population from Statistics Sweden (SCB, 2025). Points that belong to the same place (stations along a trail, machines in one park) are merged into one site.

OpenStreetMap misses many outdoor gyms: in a spot check on 23 November 2026, 11 of 17 municipalities with 0 here had at least one. Treat the figures as what is mapped, not what exists.

Method, charts and the full ranking: amblecoach.com/sv/data/utegymsindex.
